business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Emirates NBD Bank (P.J.S.C) [ENBD] infused approximately USD 2.75 billion (~INR 260 billion) to acquire 92,91,34,820 shares of RBL Bank at a price of Rs. 280 on 18 June 2026 by way of a preferential issue on a private placement basis; ENBD holds 60% of the expanded share capital and has been classified as a promoter of the Bank.
- "RBL Bank provides ENBD with a scalable platform in India, offering significant cross-border synergies"; 5 Non-Executive Non-Independent Directors have been appointed on the Board as Nominees of ENBD.
- ENBD is described as "UAE's most profitable Bank... a leading banking group in the MENAT (Middle East, North Africa and Türkiye) region with a presence in 13 countries, serving 10+ million active customers", listed on the Dubai Financial Market with market capitalisation of ~USD 54 billion.
- Distribution: 628 Branches, 1,339 BC Branches, 410 ATMs and 15.04 Mn Customers, covering "600+ districts, servicing 18,000+ pincodes".
- Digital payments franchise claims: 7th rank in the industry in IMPS as Remitter Bank, +10% market share in Merchant Acquiring value of transactions, 3rd rank in the industry in Foreign Inward Remittance (FIR) through IMPS, and "Among Top 3 banks in the Industry for processing Indo-Nepal Remittances".

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)
capital_allocation.body:
- Capital adequacy ratio & CET-1 including Q1FY27 profits as of 30th June 2026 was 33.3% & 32.2% vs 14.2% & 12.8% as of 31st March 2026 — a step change driven by the ENBD preferential issue.
- Net Worth rose to Rs.423.33 bn in Q1FY27 from Rs.160.14 bn in FY26 (Capital Rs.15.49 bn, +154% YoY; Reserves and Surplus Rs.413.28 bn, +171% YoY); BVPS at 273.37 vs 259.08 in FY26.
- Borrowings fell 34% YoY / 42% QoQ to Rs.98.03 bn while Investments (Net) rose 59% YoY to Rs.377.77 bn; Balances with other banks rose 121% YoY to Rs.126.06 bn.
- Ratings: Issuer Rating ICRA AAA (Stable) assigned Jul 07, 2026; Basel III Tier II bonds ICRA AAA (Stable) re-affirmed and CARE AAA (Stable) upgraded Jul 10, 2026; Infrastructure Bonds CRISIL AAA (Stable) assigned Jun 22, 2026; short term instruments at ICRA A1+ / CRISIL A1+ / CARE A1+.
- Deck footnote flags the dilution effect on returns: "Q1FY27 RoE excluding capital infusion stands at ~5%" against reported Return on Equity of 4.01%.

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Merger pending] "The Amalgamation of the three branches of ENBD operating in India into RBL Bank is awaiting final approvals from authorities".
- [Shareholding] Promoter (ENBD) 60.0%, VCF/MF/Pension Funds/Insurance 17.0%, Individual/HUFs 9.5%, FPI 8.8%, Foreign Corporates 1.4%, Body Corporates 2.5%, NRIs 0.5%, Others 0.4%; "Total Foreign holding : 70.5%".
- [Deposit balance] Deposits (EOP) at Rs.1,248.29 bn were up 11% YoY but down 10% QoQ from Rs.1,390.18 bn in March 2026, even as average deposits grew 24% YoY — the deck presents average and EOP deposits separately without reconciling the divergence.
- [Cross-border partnerships] Partnerships established with Comera Pay and Ark Ventures for RDA-based remittances; NIYO onboarded in GIFT City for USD e-wallet solutions for Indian students; FX settlement services enabled for NIUM; USD 1.7 bn value processed in Q1 FY27 under RDA (93% growth vs Q1 FY 26); RBI approval received for "Salary Payouts" under RDA Cross-Border.
- [Awards] 'Best Data Quality' Award (Silver Category) by TransUnion CIBIL; FINNOVITI 2026 Awards by Banking Frontiers for Confirmation Service API, KAVACH (AI-powered fraud detection) and RInsights.
